Bindings.OpenTheXamlIn: Open the XAML in your editor (Settings › Editor)
Bindings.RuntimeBindingFailuresWrong: Runtime binding failures (wrong paths, null DataContext, converter exceptions) appear here as they happen.
Connections.AddTheSpyglassAgent: Add the Spyglass agent to your Avalonia app. It connects automatically; press Ctrl+Shift+I (⌘⌥I) in the app to bring Spyglass forward.
Connections.WaitingForAnApp: Waiting for an app to connect
Editor.CouldNotStart: Could not start {0}. Is it installed and on PATH? You can change the editor in Settings › Editor.
Editor.NoCommand: No editor command is set. Enter one in Settings › Editor, e.g.  code --goto {file}:{line}:{column}
Editor.NoLocation: No XAML location (Release build, or the element was created in code).
Editor.NotAFile: Cannot open {0}: it is not a file on disk (the app was built without source paths, or it is an embedded resource).
Editor.VsWindowsOnly: Visual Studio can only be launched from Spyglass on Windows. Pick another editor in Settings.
Elements.OpenTheXamlIn: Open the XAML in your editor (Settings › Editor)
Elements.PickAnElementIn: Pick an element in the app (Ctrl+Shift+C / ⌘⇧C)
Elements.StyleSourcesNeedThe: Style sources need the advanced agent: use UseSpyglassAdvanced()
Events.EmptyPaused: Recording is paused. Press Record to capture events.
Events.EmptyRecording: Interact with the app: clicks, key presses and the other checked events appear here.
Events.NotSupported: This app's agent cannot trace events. Update Spyglass.Agent.
Events.SelectAnEventTo: Select an event to see the elements it travelled through and which one handled it.
Logs.ChangeFilter: Change the level, area or search filter to see more.
Logs.ClearTheListThe: Clear the list (the app keeps recording)
Logs.EmptyDescription: Avalonia warnings and errors (layout, rendering, properties, bindings…) appear here as they happen. Recording {0} and above.
Logs.FilterByMessageArea: Filter by message, area or element
Logs.ShowTipGone: This object is not in the element tree (or no longer exists)
Main.CannotListen: Cannot listen on 127.0.0.1:{0}: {1}. Is another Spyglass running?
Main.Waiting: Waiting for an app · listening on 127.0.0.1:{0} · MCP {1}
Net.AllowSensitive: Allow to generate HAR with sensitive data
Net.Col.Name: Name
Net.EmptyRecording: Perform a request in the app to see it here. You can also drop a .har file here.
Net.EmptyStopped: Press {0} to start recording. Requests are only intercepted while recording. You can also drop a .har file here.
Net.EmptyStoppedNoKey: Press the record button to start recording. Requests are only intercepted while recording. You can also drop a .har file here.
Net.SaveHarSensitive: Save all as HAR (with sensitive data)…
Net.SizeTip: Resource size (decoded). HttpClient decompresses before Spyglass sees the body, so the transferred size is not available.
Network.CookiesAddedByCookiecontainer: Cookies added by CookieContainer are not visible to Spyglass.
Network.DragToSelectA: Drag to select a time range, double-click to reset
Network.ImportHarFileOr: Import HAR file… (or drop it on the table)
Network.ProvisionalHeadersAreShown: Provisional headers are shown. Headers added by the HTTP handler (such as Host, Cookie from CookieContainer, Accept-Encoding) are not included.
Network.SearchAcrossRequestsHeaders: Search across requests: headers, payloads, responses  (Enter)
Network.ShowAResponseHeader: Show a response header (for example Server or Cache-Control) as a column.
Perf.DiagnosticsOff: Avalonia diagnostics are off in this app (SpyglassAgentOptions.EnableAvaloniaDiagnostics).
Perf.NoFramesLastActive: no frames this second · last active {0}: {1:0} fps
Perf.NoFramesYet: no frames yet: nothing has changed in the app
Performance.AvaloniaOnlyRendersAnd: Avalonia only renders and lays out when something changes. Move the mouse over the app, type, scroll, resize its window or start an animation, and the numbers below fill in.
Performance.DrawnByAvaloniaInside: Drawn by Avalonia inside the app's window; restored when you disconnect.
Performance.HotSpotsSinceThe: Hot spots since the page was opened (self time)
Performance.LiveWhileThisPage: live while this page is open
Performance.NoFramesOrLayout: No frames or layout passes in the last 10 seconds. The table fills in as soon as the app does something.
Performance.NoIssuesDetectedNon: No issues detected (non-virtualized lists, very large visual trees, slow layout).
Performance.NothingRecordedYetInteract: Nothing recorded yet. Interact with the app: styles, resources and layout are profiled while you do.
Performance.SamplesArriveOnceA: Samples arrive once a second while this page is open. Profiling stops when you leave it.
Performance.TheAppIsIdle: The app is idle: there is nothing to measure right now
Performance.ThisAppSAgent: This app's agent has no performance metrics: Avalonia diagnostics are switched off (EnableAvaloniaDiagnostics) or the agent is too old.
Resources.ConnectAnAppThen: Connect an app, then reload. Select an element on the Elements page to include its own resources.
Resources.EmptyProviderText: Its keys live in the dictionaries listed below it in the tree.
Resources.EmptyProviderTitle: This provider has no keys of its own
Resources.NoKeysMatchText: Nothing in this provider contains that text in its key or value. Use Lookup to search the whole app.
Resources.NotDefined: {0} is not defined for the {1} theme from here.
Resources.PickADictionaryOn: Pick a dictionary on the left to see its keys.
Resources.ResourcesInsideControlTemplate: Resources inside control templates are not listed.
Resources.StartAtApp: Start at the application (no element selected)
Resources.ThisValueCannotBe: This value cannot be edited live (templates, collections and other objects are read-only). Edits never add or remove keys.
Resources.TypeAKeyOr: Type a key, or select an entry and press Resolve. The chain shows every provider searched, nearest first: what the key means for {DynamicResource Key} on that element.
Resources.WhereDoesAKey: Where does a key resolve from?
Resources.WhereDoesThisKey: Where does this key resolve from, and what does it override?
Settings.AppliesTheNextTime: Applies the next time recording starts.
Settings.CapturesTheCallStack: Captures the call stack for the Initiator column. Slightly more work per request.
Settings.HintCustom: Placeholders: {file}  {line}  {column}. Use double quotes around arguments with spaces.
Settings.HintRider: Runs  rider --line N --column N file  (on macOS also tries `open -b com.jetbrains.rider`).
Settings.HintSystem: Opens the file with the system's default application (no line number).
Settings.HintVs: Runs  devenv /Edit file  (opens the file, not the line).
Settings.HintVsCode: Runs  code --goto file:line:column  (on macOS also tries `open -b com.microsoft.VSCode`).
Settings.HintVsWindowsOnly: Visual Studio can only be started from Windows.
Settings.IncludeTheInsidesOf: Include the insides of control templates in the element tree.
Settings.KeepTheHighlightIn: Keep the highlight in the app
Settings.KeyBringForward: Bring Spyglass forward (starts it if it is not running)
Settings.KeyPick: Pick an element; Spyglass selects it. Esc cancels
Settings.LanguageHint: Language of the Spyglass window. Applies immediately.
Settings.LargerBodiesAreCounted: Larger bodies are counted but only the first part is kept.
Settings.OffKeepsOnlyHeaders: Off keeps only headers and timings (less memory, nothing sensitive stored).
Settings.OtherwiseTheBlueBox: Otherwise the blue box around the selected element fades after 1.5 seconds.
Settings.PortNote: Debugged apps connect to this port. Changing it takes effect the next time Spyglass starts; apps must use the same port (UseSpyglass(o => o.Port = …) or SPYGLASS_PORT).
Settings.PortSaved: Saved: apps connect to {0} after the next start of Spyglass (currently listening on {1}).
Settings.RecordWhereEachRequest: Record where each request was sent from
Settings.ReducedKeepsFadesBut: Reduced keeps fades but drops movement; Off disables all animation.
Settings.RequestsAreOnlyIntercepted: Requests are only intercepted while recording. Turn off to start by hand (Ctrl/⌘ E).
Settings.SaveFailed: Could not write {0}: settings apply now but will not be remembered.
Settings.SpyglassOnlyListensOn: Spyglass only listens on this machine (127.0.0.1). Connections from other machines are not supported yet.
Settings.StartRecordingWhenThe: Start recording when the Network page opens
Settings.TheInAppShortcuts: The in-app shortcuts are options of the agent: UseSpyglass(o => { o.OpenGesture = …; o.InspectGesture = …; }). Set them to null to disable.
Settings.UsedByTheOpen: Used by the 'Open in editor' buttons next to XAML locations (Debug builds of your app).
Settings.WhenTheListIs: When the list is full the oldest events are dropped.
